scenarios.title: A｜询问需要的材料
scenarios.setting: 玩家来到银行，准备开设一个账户。

turns.text: Hi. How can I help you today?

turns.prompt: 关于「开设银行账户」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to open a bank account.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to open a bank account.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I’m interested in opening an account here.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m interested in opening an account here.
feedback.explanation: “interested in”表示对某事感兴趣，可以接具体爱好来展开聊天。

choices.text: Could you tell me what I need to open an account?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me what I need to open an account?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d like to know what documents I need to bring.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to know what documents I need to bring.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I want to make a bank account.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to open a bank account.
feedback.explanation: 银行开户的固定搭配是“open a bank account”，不用“make”。

turns.text: Sure. Do you have some identification with you?

turns.prompt: 关于「开设银行账户」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yes, I have my passport.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I have my passport.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I have my passport and proof of address.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have my passport and proof of address.
feedback.explanation: “proof of address”指地址证明，办事时可据此确认需要提供什么材料。

choices.text: I have my ID, but I don’t have proof of address with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have my ID, but I don’t have proof of address with me.
feedback.explanation: “proof of address”指地址证明，办事时可据此确认需要提供什么材料。

choices.text: What forms of ID do you accept?

feedback.naturalExpression: What forms of ID do you accept?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

turns.text: We’ll need to verify your identity and some other information.

turns.prompt: 你想确认开户还需要补充什么材料，会怎么说？

choices.text: Is there anything else I need to provide?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything else I need to provide?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Do I need to provide proof of income?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to provide proof of income?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Do I need to make an initial deposit?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to make an initial deposit?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Can I complete everything today?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I complete everything today?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

scenarios.title: B｜选择账户
scenarios.setting: 在“开设银行账户”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“选择账户”。

turns.text: What kind of account are you looking for?

turns.prompt: 关于「开设银行账户」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like an account for everyday spending.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like an account for everyday spending.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: I’m mainly looking for an account to receive my salary and pay bills.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m mainly looking for an account to receive my salary and pay bills.
feedback.explanation: “looking for”表示正在寻找，区别于强调找到结果的“find”。

choices.text: I’d also like to save some money. What options do you have?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d also like to save some money. What options do you have?
feedback.explanation: “what options”询问可选方案，便于在了解条件后作决定。

choices.text: I’m not sure. Could you explain the different types of accounts?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure. Could you explain the different types of accounts?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Which account is the best?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like an account for everyday spending.
feedback.explanation: “best”取决于用途；说明日常消费、储蓄或收费需求，工作人员才好推荐账户。

turns.text: We have a few different options. Some accounts have monthly fees, while others have certain balance requirements.

turns.prompt: 你想确认是否收费、是否包含在内，会怎么问？

choices.text: Does this account have a monthly fee?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does this account have a monthly fee?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Is there a minimum balance I need to keep?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a minimum balance I need to keep?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: What’s the difference between these two accounts?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the difference between these two accounts?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: Does this account come with a debit card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Does this account come with a debit card?
feedback.explanation: 核实某项内容是否包含在内，能避免双方对配料、配件或费用作不同假设。

turns.text: This one has no monthly fee if you meet the requirements, and it comes with a debit card.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方介绍的账户方案，会怎么说？

choices.text: That sounds like the better option for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds like the better option for me.
feedback.explanation: “sounds like”表示根据对方的描述形成的印象，不是声称自己已经直接了解全部情况。

choices.text: I think I’d like to go with this one.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’d like to go with this one.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Before I decide, are there any other fees I should know about?

feedback.naturalExpression: Before I decide, are there any other fees I should know about?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: Can I use the debit card abroad?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I use the debit card abroad?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

turns.text: All right. I’ll just need you to fill out this form.

turns.prompt: 你想确认开户表格有哪些填写要求，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. Is there anything I should pay special attention to?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Is there anything I should pay special attention to?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Okay. Should I fill out all of these sections?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Should I fill out all of these sections?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: What should I put here?

feedback.naturalExpression: What should I put here?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Could you help me with this part? I’m not sure what it means.

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me with this part? I’m not sure what it means.
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Of course. Once you’ve completed the form, I’ll check everything for you.

turns.prompt: 你想请工作人员检查开户资料是否完整，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve finished the form. Could you check it for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve finished the form. Could you check it for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I think that’s everything. Do you need anything else from me?

feedback.naturalExpression: I think that’s everything. Do you need anything else from me?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Here you go. Please let me know if I’ve missed anything.

feedback.naturalExpression: Here you go. Please let me know if I’ve missed anything.
feedback.explanation: “here you go”递交或展示物品时使用，让对方知道所需东西已经准备好。

turns.text: Everything looks good. Your account has been opened successfully.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Great. When will I receive my debit card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. When will I receive my debit card?
feedback.explanation: 询问时间或时机，便于对方给出具体安排，减少对等待或操作时间的猜测。

choices.text: How do I set up online banking?

feedback.naturalExpression: How do I set up online banking?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Can I start using the account right away?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I start using the account right away?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: How can I deposit money into the account?

feedback.naturalExpression: How can I deposit money into the account?
feedback.explanation: “deposit”指押金或订金，具体是否退还需看当前安排。

turns.text: I’ll explain the next steps and give you your account information.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. Thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Great, thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。
